brand.name: LG
brand.notes: LG AC for PK market (LG Electronics Korea — Dual Inverter, Art Cool, Multi F(DX) split; Multi V VRF partial). Primary sources: official LG help-library Guide to Error Codes (CH family, high) + Universal Split Fault Codes Sheet (Macedo/Orion, service manual PDF, high) + Multi F(DX) fault sheet (high) + official DFS-TP-AH-001-US tech paper (high) + Ample Air Multi V CH partial (medium). Numeric split codes (01-10 indoor / 21-105 outdoor) vs CH## family kept in separate series files (different display/product lines). No PK-localized official table (lg.com/pk 403; US/Africa mirrors used as same family). Quarantines: LG TV/mobile/fridge/washer, other-brand tables, most Multi V module codes out of PK residential scope.
